milestones.title: M0
milestones.description: Public fixture-only contract, identity gate, executable privacy boundaries, reproducible planning, and CI evidence.

milestones.title: M1
milestones.description: Typed evidence core, revocable consent, production Keychain lifecycle, hardened SQLite WAL storage, bounded writer, and crash recovery.

milestones.title: M2
milestones.description: Opt-in selected-root FSEvents collection with path containment, volume-aware cursors, first-class gaps, storm recovery, and benchmarks.

milestones.title: M3
milestones.description: Snapshot-stable queries, evidence-claim grammar, deterministic explanation, streaming export, retention, deletion limits, integrity, and archives.

milestones.title: M4
milestones.description: Explicit shell and Git integrations, frontmost-application context, adversarial privacy tests, and cross-source developer workflow evaluation.

milestones.title: M5
milestones.description: Constrained browser adapters, authenticated local service, accessible read-only UI, and reversible launchd lifecycle.

milestones.title: M6
milestones.description: v1 readiness: reproducible signed and notarized artifacts, SBOM and provenance, performance gates, compatibility, red-team, incident drills, and Endpoint Security decision.

milestones.title: M7
milestones.description: v1.1 operational resilience: diagnostics, backup and recovery, annual macOS compatibility, accessibility, distribution strategy, and telemetry-free support.

milestones.title: M8
milestones.description: Interoperability with explicit imported-evidence trust, W3C PROV, bounded offline telemetry import, adapter capabilities and conformance, and encrypted bundles.

milestones.title: M9
milestones.description: Research-grade evaluation of causal precision, coverage, abstention, gap comprehension, privacy leakage, longitudinal cost, and reproducibility.

milestones.title: M10
milestones.description: Governed ecosystem extensibility with stable adapter contracts, isolation decision, signing and revocation, conformance evidence, governance, and platform feasibility.

milestones.title: M11
milestones.description: v2 and long-term support gate: format and crypto migration, verified compaction, LTS policy, independent audit, release-candidate migration, and 2032 sustainability decision.
